title: How hacking became a key weapon for sanctions-hit North Korea
paragraphs: How hacking became a key weapon for sanctions-hit North Korea
The US$6.3 billion stolen in the Binance crypto theft is equivalent to about one-sixth of North Korea's annual national income, according to an analyst.

SEOUL: The recent US$6.3 billion Binance cryptocurrency theft, which the United States’ Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has blamed on North Korea, has drawn fresh attention to the country's cyber capabilities and their growing importance to Pyongyang.
